question: "Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas" is observed on the birth anniversary of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birsa Munda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas** is observed on the **birth anniversary **of** Birsa Munda,** who was a tribal leader and **freedom fighter from Jharkhand.**
 
• The day is celebrated to honor the **contributions of tribal communities** in India and to promote their** cultural heritage and identity.**
 
• Birsa Munda is known for his role in the** Munda Rebellion against British colonial rule **in the late 19th century.
 
• The day is celebrated with various** cultural programs, exhibitions, and workshops **to showcase the rich cultural diversity of tribal communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**, also known as the** Father of the Nation**, is celebrated on his birth anniversary on **2nd October as Gandhi Jayanti**, a national holiday in India.
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel,** also known as the **Iron Man of India**, is celebrated on his birth anniversary on **31st October **as** National Unity Day, **to commemorate his efforts in uniting India after independence.
 
• **B.R. Ambedkar**, also known as the **Architect of the Indian Constitution**, is celebrated on his birth anniversary on **14th April as Ambedkar Jayanti,** to honor his contributions towards **social justice and equality **in India.
